flat_steps.title: Define architecture & technical decisions
flat_steps.notes: Unified greenfield — step 1 of 5: scope, ADRs, API style, data model. Focus on architectural decisions before implementation. Use candidates for database and API depth (REST/GraphQL/tRPC). First ADR path follows init.architecture / init.documentation (docs/adrs/); fork the manifest if your team uses another ADR root.
verify_commands: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='docs/adrs/0001-record-architecture-decisions.md';if(!fs.existsSync(p)){console.error('Missing ADR file: '+p);process.exit(1);}const b=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');const checks=['# ','## Context','## Decision','## Consequences'];const miss=checks.filter((c)=>!b.toLowerCase().includes(c.toLowerCase()));if(miss.length){console.error('ADR missing required sections: '+miss.join(', '));process.exit(1);}"

flat_steps.title: Project scaffold & repository layout
flat_steps.notes: Unified greenfield — step 2 of 5: boilerplate and folder layout; optional convention and shared foundation via candidates. Keep this step to baseline scaffolding (not product features). README + specs index per setup.project-init.

skill_candidates.label: Node / generic backend layout
skill_candidates.when: Express, Nest, or generic Node backend structure.

skill_candidates.label: Lint, format, git hooks
skill_candidates.when: ESLint, Prettier, Husky, EditorConfig after skeleton exists.

skill_candidates.label: Test-first slices for foundation code
skill_candidates.when: DTOs, env schema, HTTP client, unified errors — keep red/green commits small.

verify_commands: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const files=['README.md','docs/specs/README.md'];for(const p of files){if(!fs.existsSync(p)){console.error('Missing required file: '+p);process.exit(1);}const b=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');if(b.replace(/\s+/g,'').length<120){console.error('File too thin for baseline docs: '+p);process.exit(1);}}"

flat_steps.title: Environment & local runtime
flat_steps.notes: Unified greenfield — step 3 of 5: containers, compose, env files, local dependencies. Omitted when phase environment is disabled in workflow profile. Primary local-dev artifact per init.env.docker: docker-compose.yml (add Dockerfile in the same step if the stack uses it).
verify_commands: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='docker-compose.yml';if(!fs.existsSync(p)){console.error('Missing file: '+p);process.exit(1);}const b=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');if(!/^\s*services\s*:/m.test(b)){console.error('docker-compose.yml must define services.');process.exit(1);}if(!/version\s*:|name\s*:|services\s*:/m.test(b)){console.error('docker-compose.yml looks invalid or empty.');process.exit(1);}"

flat_steps.title: CI/CD & quality pipeline
flat_steps.notes: Unified greenfield — step 4 of 5: lint, test, build, deploy hooks; branch protection. Omitted when phase pipeline is disabled in workflow profile. Default path for GitHub Actions (init.pipeline); GitLab or other CI: fork manifest or adjust expected_artifacts.
verify_commands: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='.github/workflows/ci.yml';if(!fs.existsSync(p)){console.error('Missing CI workflow file: '+p);process.exit(1);}const b=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');if(!/^\s*jobs\s*:/m.test(b)){console.error('CI workflow must define jobs.');process.exit(1);}if(!/\bon\s*:/m.test(b)){console.error('CI workflow should define triggers under on:.');process.exit(1);}if(!/(npm|pnpm|yarn|pytest|go test|cargo test|dotnet test|mvn test|gradle test)/i.test(b)){console.error('CI workflow should include at least one test/build command.');process.exit(1);}"

flat_steps.title: Generate project documentation
flat_steps.notes: Unified greenfield — step 5 of 5: README, CONTRIBUTING, onboarding from prior steps' outputs. CONTRIBUTING.md is mandatory per init.documentation (README + docs/specs often exist after step 2).

skill_candidates.label: General QA docs writing
skill_candidates.when: Broader docs tone, OpenAPI, or team doc standards beyond init bundle.

verify_commands: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='CONTRIBUTING.md';if(!fs.existsSync(p)){console.error('Missing file: '+p);process.exit(1);}const b=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');const req=['setup','test','pull request'];const miss=req.filter((k)=>!new RegExp(k,'i').test(b));if(miss.length){console.error('CONTRIBUTING.md should cover: '+miss.join(', '));process.exit(1);}if(b.replace(/\s+/g,'').length<180){console.error('CONTRIBUTING.md is too short for onboarding baseline.');process.exit(1);}"
